import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class A {
    private static boolean check(long W, long M, long x) {
        if (x == M) return true;
        x += M;
        while (x > 0) {
            if (x % W > 1) return false;
            x /= W;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] s = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        long W = Long.parseLong(s[0]);
        long M = Long.parseLong(s[1]);

        if (W == 2) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            System.exit(0);
        }

        ArrayList<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();
        powers.add(1L);
        powers.add(W);
        long cur = W;
        while (true) {
            cur *= W;
            if (cur < 0 || cur > 10000000000L) break;
            powers.add(cur);
        }

        int n = powers.size();
        long limit = 1L << n;
        boolean ok = false;

        for (long mask = 0L; mask < limit; mask++) {
            long x = 0L;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((mask & (1L << i)) != 0L) x += powers.get(i);
            }
            if (check(W, M, x)) {
                ok = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ok ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}

        x += M;
        while (x > 0) {
            if (x % W > 1) return false;
            x /= W;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static void generate(List<Long> powers, int start, int end, long sum, List<Long> out) {
        if (start == end) {
            out.add(sum);
            return;
        }
        generate(powers, start + 1, end, sum + powers.get(start), out);
        generate(powers, start + 1, end, sum, out);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] s = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        long W = Long.parseLong(s[0]);

            System.exit(0);
        }

        ArrayList<Long> powers = new ArrayList<>();

        powers.add(W);
        long cur = W;
        while (true) {
            cur *= W;
            if (cur < 0 || cur > 10000000000L) break;
            powers.add(cur);
        }

        int mid = powers.size() / 2;
        ArrayList<Long> left = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Long> right = new ArrayList<>();

        generate(powers, 0, mid, 0L, left);
        generate(powers, mid, powers.size(), 0L, right);

        boolean found = false;

                if (check(W, M, a + b)) {
                    found = true;
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(found ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
